exit 0
--- stdout
| usage: spine COMMAND ARGUMENTS [OPTIONS]
|
| Mechanical checks for state-machine specs, and conformance of code to them.
|
| commands:
|   spine check SPEC [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|   spine hash SPEC
|   spine diff A B [--format text|json] [--junit FILE] [--depth N]
|   spine stale SPEC CHECKS_DIR [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|   spine behaviors SPEC DIR [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|   spine trace SPEC FILE [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|   spine conform SPEC --adapter-cmd COMMAND [--format text|json] [--junit FILE] [--depth N]
|   spine guard POLICY [FILES ...] --branch NAME [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|
| spine COMMAND --help describes one command.
|

exit 0
--- stdout
| usage: spine behaviors SPEC DIR [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|
| Replays every file in DIR/valid/, which must be allowed, and DIR/invalid/, which must be refused.
|
| options:
|   --format text|json       how the findings are printed; text unless given
|   --junit FILE             also write the findings as a JUnit XML report
|   -h, --help               show this help
|

| usage: spine check SPEC [--format text|json] [--junit FILE]
|
| Validates SPEC, then checks that every state, event and variable combination has exactly one

| they say.
|

--- stdout
| usage: spine conform SPEC --adapter-cmd COMMAND [--format text|json] [--junit FILE] [--depth N]
|
| Runs every event sequence up to the depth against the spine and against the code, through the
| adapter, and reports where they differ.
|
| options:
|   --adapter-cmd COMMAND    the adapter's command line, split as a shell would and run without one
|   --format text|json       how the findings are printed; text unless given
|   --junit FILE             also write the findings as a JUnit XML report
|   --depth N                the longest event sequence tried, 1 or more; 4 unless given
|   -h, --help               show this help
|

| usage: spine diff A B [--format text|json] [--junit FILE] [--depth N]
|
| Compares two spines case by case, then by behavior over every event sequence up to the depth,
| reporting the shortest sequence for each difference.
|
| options:
|   --format text|json       how the findings are printed; text unless given
|   --junit FILE             also write the findings as a JUnit XML report
|   --depth N                the longest event sequence tried, 1 or more; 4 unless given
|   -h, --help               show this help
